title: Respiratory Picornavirus Genotyping Conventional Nested RT-PCR
author: Ian M Mackay
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.9tyh6pw
materials: SuperScript III One-Step RT-PCR System with Platinum Taq Invitrogen - Thermo Fisher Catalog #12457-026 MyFi Mix Bioline Catalog #BIO-25049

steps.title: Prepare Round 1 and Round 2 Reaction Mixes
steps.instruction: Prepare reaction mixes for both rounds in 8x 0.2ml tube strips and freeze at -20°C in a frost-free freezer until needed.

substeps.instruction: Prepare Round 1 Mix (20µl total): 1.4µl Nuclease-free water, 10µl SensiFAST no ROX One-Step Mix (2X), 6µl Primers (600nM final), 0.4µl RNase inhibitor, 0.2µl RT/Taq, and 2µl Template (Note: Dispense 15µL to each tube initially).

Prepare Round 2 Mix (20µl total): 8.7µl Nuclease-free water, 4µl MyTaq Reaction Buffer (5X), 3.8µl Primers (380nM final), 1.4µl MgCl2 (4.75mM final), 0.2µl MyTaq HS DNA Polymerase (5U/uL), and 2µl 1st round amplicon (Note: Dispense 18µL into each tube initially).

steps.title: Perform Round 1 RT-PCR
steps.instruction: Using a SimpliAmp (Applied Biosystems) thermal cycler, transfer 5µl of nucleic acid extract (extracted RNA, controls, or NTC) to defrosted reaction tubes and run the following cycle:

substeps.instruction: 94°C for 18 sec, 50°C for 21 sec, 72°C for 90 sec (35X)

steps.title: Perform Round 2 PCR
steps.instruction: Using a SimpliAmp (Applied Biosystems) thermal cycler, transfer 2µl of 1:100 pre-diluted Round 1 amplicon into defrosted 0.2ml reaction tubes and start the cycle at 95°C for 1 min (1X).

steps.title: Analyze Amplicons via Electrophoresis
steps.instruction: Electrophorese 2-5µl of the amplicon on a 1.5% agarose gel in 0.5X TBE buffer.
